label: At GO, strongest after an unrewarded a2 trial; weaker after reward and when belief favors S1.
terms: (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (prev_reward == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) * (tv("action", -2) == 2) * (prev_reward == 0)
explanation: Active only at GO (D1/D2 are zero), with a timing baseline that grows over the episode. Beyond timing, magnitude is highest after an unrewarded a2 trial (both a2 S2 u and a2 S1 u, about +1.4 to +1.7 over baseline). It is lower after any rewarded trial, and it scales with how strongly the ideal-observer belief says S2 is good (negative belief_lo raises it). The free fit adds the trial before: an unrewarded trial two back raises it further, so runs of losses build it up, and an a2 choice two back lowers it slightly. Most leftover error is in long a2 loss streaks, which are under-predicted. Future variables (this choice, reward) are not needed.

issues: The reported scores check out exactly. Short form on test: 0.577. Free fit on test: 0.643, with weights matching the explanation: two-back unrewarded +0.68, two-back a2 -0.33. Calling the two-back a2 effect 'slight' understates it a little.

Each term earns its place on test. Dropping belief_lo gives 0.463. Dropping prev_reward==1 gives 0.496. Swapping belief_lo for raw belief gives 0.530. Swapping it for prev_state==1 gives 0.494. Restricting the reward term to rewards at S1 gives 0.547.

Remaining systematic error is modest. GO after a2 S1 r is over-predicted by 0.35 (its residual is -0.79, about as low as after a1 S1 r). The other previous-trial cells are off by 0.23 or less. The worst windows are long a2 losing streaks (actual about 4.9 vs predicted 1.5-2.9). The explanation already notes this and the free fit's two-back terms only partly fix it.
The future variable 'this GO choice == a2' in place of belief_lo scores 0.605 on test, only slightly better. Its observed proxy belief_lo gets most of that, so the observed-only short form stands.
None of my alternatives (streak terms, prev_state terms, other reward splits) beat 0.577 under --short.
